{{Top|leg}}
A '''tingler''',<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> also known as a '''tingler module''' or '''palm-tingler''',<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> was a device in [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]. It provided a tingle when the magazine, or power cell, was almost empty. [[Heller]] adapted one "tingler" to his [[Cresh Luck armor/Legends|Cresh Luck armor]], replacing the armor's audio warning with a subtler tingler.<ref name="GFT" />
